notes: 12 prompts selected from 24 blind-generated ideas (opus_47 + gpt_54). See prompts_raw.json for the full pool. Selection targets: 1+ per medium (7), 3 multi-medium, 2 abstract. Source attribution: [O#] = opus_47 idea #N, [G#] = gpt_54 idea #N. Light edits only — kept visual language of the source.

prompts.text: An abstract field of overlapping circular watercolor blooms in dusty pinks and ochres, their edges bleeding into each other on warm paper.

prompts.source: O8 (edited — dropped watercolor/ink to isolate pencil)
prompts.text: A botanical study of wild grasses and seed heads in graphite pencil only — fine outlines, hatching, and tonal shading, no color, unfinished edges.
A gestural figure study of a dancer mid-leap, drawn in loose charcoal with heavy smudges trailing behind the motion.
A portrait-like figure made from colored pencil only, with layered imperfect strokes in unexpected colors so the face feels more like a memory or mood than a person.
A dense black-and-white forest made only with technical-pen hatching, where tree trunks, undergrowth, and shadows become a woven pattern that almost turns abstract.
A flock of birds scattered across the page as quick marker gestures, their paths guided by an invisible swirling wind.
A city wall of overlapping spray-painted circles, drips, arrows, and ghosted hand-drawn marks, like fragments of graffiti building into an accidental composition.
A foggy harbor at dawn rendered in soft watercolor washes, with faint graphite pencil lines suggesting masts and ropes over the damp color.
A rainy city street at night suggested through wet watercolor bleeds, neon marker smears reflecting on the pavement, and sparse ink silhouettes of passersby.
A cracked desert landscape with layered sand-colored washes, jagged charcoal rock formations, and a single thin pen-drawn horizon line bisecting the page.
An abstract composition of intersecting hatched rectangles in muted earth tones, like a Diebenkorn landscape rendered in pen and colored pencil.
A swarm of particles following a vector field, each leaving a trail of spray-paint dots that build up into ghostly cloud formations.
